# Living With Arthritis UK

> UK arthritis charity offering free virtual physiotherapy, NICE-aligned exercise programmes, anti-inflammatory diet guidance, a help chat and waiting-list support for people living with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis and related conditions across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Free arthritis support — physio, diet, help chat, community.
- [About](/about): Mission, team and story of Living With Arthritis UK.
- [Services](/services): Overview of free arthritis support services.
- [Exercises](/exercises): Joint-by-joint exercise hub for arthritis.
- [Diet](/diet): Mediterranean and anti-inflammatory eating guidance.
- [Self-Help Tool](/self-help): Personalised arthritis self-management.
- [Health Tools](/health-tools): Calculators and trackers for joint health.
- [Chat](/chat): arthritis help chat.
- [FAQ](/faq): Clinician-answered arthritis questions.
- [Expert Articles](/expert-articles): Clinician-written long-form guides.
- [Impact Stories](/impact): Patient stories and charitable impact.
- [Blog](/blog): Latest arthritis news and education.
